name: DH to Xaero Bridge
description:
Shows Distant Horizons LODs on Xaero's World Map in places where no real chunk data exists. Never overwrites naturally generated map data.

Tip: wait for Distant Horizons generation to finish, then open Xaero's World Map settings and click 'Reload all regions'.

----------------------------
Credits
- Distant Horizons (the LOD data this mod reads)
- Xaero's World Map (the map this mod adds to)
- VoxyWorldGenXaero-Bridge (the mod this one is based on)

Links to all three are in the Links section.
